# Bayesian network alert context (generated by step 7)

Model used: `zscore_baseline` (max_abs_z, 99th percentile threshold). Chosen as the primary-score model detecting the most reported events on test (ties: fewest unconfirmed alerts/day). This choice does not change any threshold or model.

Per variable: -log P(observed state | Markov blanket) in nats, averaged over the windows of the alert event, against the same quantity on `calib` windows. Higher = the observed state is more unusual given its blanket. This describes association, not cause. A variable is marked unusual when the share of event windows above the calib percentile exceeds 2 times the share expected by chance.
